description.zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID。当**ApplicationType**为**Application时**，必填。和**TagIds**互斥。
description.en: Set of application IDs for the private access policy. Up to 100 application IDs can be entered. Required when **ApplicationType** is **Application**. Mutually exclusive with **TagIds**.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
- **Application**：应用。
- **Tag**：标签。
description.en:
Application type of the private access policy. Values:
- **Application**: Application.
- **Tag**: Tag.

description.zh: 内网访问策略的自定义用户组集合，当用户组类型为**Custom**时，必填。和用户组ID集合互斥。最多可输入10个自定义用户组。
description.en: Set of custom user groups for the private access policy. Required when the user group type is **Custom**. Mutually exclusive with the user group ID set. Up to 10 custom user groups can be entered.

description.zh: 内网访问策略描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格。
description.en: Description of the private access policy. The length is 1 to 128 characters, supporting Chinese and uppercase and lowercase English letters, and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

description.zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：

- **Block**：拦截。
- **Observe**：观察。
description.en:
The execution policy for not meeting the security baseline. Values:

- **Block**: Block.
- **Observe**: Observe.

description.zh: 安全基线策略的ID。
description.en: The ID of the security baseline policy.

description.zh: 内网访问策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: Name of the private access policy. The length is 1 to 128 characters, supporting Chinese and uppercase and lowercase English letters, and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
- **Block**：阻断。
- **Allow**：允许。
description.en:
Action of the private access policy. Values:
- **Block**: Block.
- **Allow**: Allow.

description.zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1~1000，最大值为内网访问策略总数。
description.en: The priority of the private access policy. The number 1 indicates the highest priority. Range: 1~1000, with the maximum value being the total number of private access policies.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the private access policy. Values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

description.zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问标签ID。当**ApplicationType**为**Tag时**，必填。和**ApplicationIds**互斥。
description.en: Set of tag IDs for the private access policy. Up to 100 tag IDs can be entered. Required when **ApplicationType** is **Tag**. Mutually exclusive with **ApplicationIds**.

description.zh: 触发模板ID
description.en: The trigger template ID.

description.zh: 可信进程组ID。
description.en: The ID of the trusted process group.

description.zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The switch status of the trusted process. Values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

description.zh: 可信软件ID。
description.en: The ID of the trusted software.

description.zh: 内网访问策略的用户组ID集合，当用户组类型为**Normal**时，必填。和自定义用户组集合互斥。最多可输入2000个用户组ID。
description.en: Set of user group IDs for the private access policy. Required when the user group type is **Normal**. Mutually exclusive with the custom user group set. Up to 2000 user group IDs can be entered.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
- **Normal**：普通用户组。
- **Custom**：自定义用户组。
description.en:
User group type of the private access policy. Values:
- **Normal**: Normal user group.
- **Custom**: Custom user group.

description.zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳。
description.en: The start time when the zero trust policy takes effect, represented as a timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en: Switch status for effective time. Values: - **Enabled**: On. - **Disabled**: Off.

description.zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳。
description.en: The expiration time of the zero trust policy, in seconds timestamp.

descriptions.zh: 默认最多可创建500个内网访问策略。
descriptions.en: By default, up to 500 private access policies can be created.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas create-private-access-policy --name private_access_policy_name --description '这是一条内网访问策略' --policy-action Allow --application-type Application --application-ids pa-application-f4dd77bced900000 --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --user-group-mode Normal --user-group-ids usergroup-927a4c7fee940000 --custom-user-attributes Relation=Equal IdpId=12 UserGroupType=department Value=OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉 --status Enabled --priority 1 --device-attribute-id dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --device-attribute-action Block --trigger-template-id dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --trusted-process-status Enabled --trusted-process-group-ids pg-xxxxxxxxx --trusted-software-ids swb-xxxxxxx --valid-from 0 --valid-until 1764727544 --valid-time-status Disabled --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas CreatePrivateAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --CustomUserAttributes.1.IdpId 12 --Description '这是一条内网访问策略' --TrustedSoftwareIds.1 'swb-xxxxxxx' --Priority 1 --CustomUserAttributes.1.Relation Equal --CustomUserAttributes.1.Value 'OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉' --CustomUserAttributes.1.UserGroupType department --Name private_access_policy_name --TrustedProcessStatus Enabled --ValidUntil 1764727544 --UserGroupMode Normal --TriggerTemplateId 'dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ValidTimeStatus Disabled --ApplicationType Application --UserGroupIds.1 'usergroup-927a4c7fee940000' --DeviceAttributeAction Block --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --DeviceAttributeId 'dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationIds.1 'pa-application-f4dd77bced900000' --ValidFrom 0 --PolicyAction Allow --TrustedProcessGroupIds.1 'pg-xxxxxxxxx' --method POST --force
